_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: Third interior RP spec (after SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP and SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_INT_RP). Combined prime + finish. Context prefix TMRP (trim repaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. TSK_TRIM_* is NC trim paint; TSK_SETUP_* is NC trim prime setup. WLRP is wall RP; CLRP is ceiling RP. TMRP is unique. NC trim uses two separate specs (SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME with TSK_SETUP_*/TSK_TRIM_*/TSK_MDF_*, and SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT with TSK_TRIM_*). RP combines both phases under TMRP_ prefix for new/modified tasks.

paintable_items.name: Baseboard
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from NC trim specs. Same physical item in RP context. No phase suffix needed — trim NC specs are phase-split but share the same ITM_ IDs across both SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME and SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT.

paintable_items.name: Crown molding
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing. Height modifier (H2/H3) applies to crown tasks.

paintable_items.name: Door casing
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing. Adjacency with door_frame surface.

paintable_items.name: Window casing
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing. Adjacency with window_frame surface.

paintable_items.name: Picture rail
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing. Height modifier (H2/H3) applies like crown.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_TRIM_* is used by NC trim paint (SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT). TSK_SETUP_* is used by NC trim prime (SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME). TSK_MDF_* is used by NC trim prime MDF tasks. TSK_WLRP_* is wall RP. TSK_CLRP_* is ceiling RP. TSK_TMRP_* is unique for interior trim RP. Checked against id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use — TMRP not present.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_TMRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (DEGLOSS, SCRAPE_LOOSE, FEATHER_EDGES, PRIME_ADHESION_BRUSH, ASSESS_CONDITION, etc.). ALL tasks in this combined RP spec use the TMRP_ prefix — both new RP tasks and tasks adapted from NC. Direct NC task transfers are re-issued under TSK_TMRP_* for prefix consistency in the combined spec.

expected_modules.notes: Furniture clear (occupied), floor perimeter protection, wall masking (always in RP), fixture covers (spray only)

RP-specific: condition scan, adhesion test (ASTM D3359), coating ID (solvent test). No NC equivalent. FIXED time tasks. Assessment phase maps to prep in phase enum — no 'assessment' phase value exists.
Degloss, scrape/feather (FAIR/POOR), caulk assess/replace, contamination treatment (mildew/smoke), fill/patch, dust removal
State-driven primer: adhesion (SYS_PRIMER_ADHESION_INT), stain-block (SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT), mildew (SYS_PRIMER_MILDEW_INT). Conditional on substrate_state. Brush/spray variants.
Light sand primer, inspect primer coverage, touch-up caulk/fill revealed defects, clean dust. Fine-finish protocol at all tiers.
Finish coat 1 (brush/spray), interstage inspect + sand between + patch + spot coat, finish coat 2 (brush/spray), optional coat 3 at QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3
Protection teardown, furniture restore, customer walkthrough (occupied), tool clean, final inspection
Shared lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_META.BOOL.HOME_PRE_1978. Shared across all interior RP specs. Pre-existing shared module — not owned by this spec. Trim is HIGH RISK for lead paint.

paintscope_keys.description: Interior substrate state classification (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT through SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE). Drives primer selection logic.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). Distinct from SURFACE_CONDITION (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) which drives prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating home built before 1978, triggering RRP lead-safe module.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). Trim is HIGH RISK for lead paint.

paintscope_keys.description: Contamination type: none, mildew, smoke, water_stain. Drives primer selection and treatment task activation.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). Interior RP contamination-specific treatment tasks.

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded for trim — trim is a fine-finish surface per NC convention and Fine_Finish_Doctrine. QT3 is minimum for trim.

application_method.notes: Brush is primary for trim at all tiers. Spray available but requires wall masking. Roll is NOT valid for trim — profiles cannot be rolled effectively. spray_backroll not applicable to trim. No spray_rolloff.

sheen.notes: Satin default at QT3. Semi-gloss at QT4+. Gloss at QT5 only. Flat/matte/eggshell NOT valid trim sheens per Fine_Finish_Doctrine.

phase.notes: Assessment tasks map to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value exists in controlled_enums. 'apply' omitted from values because spec uses prime/finish directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: LF is primary UOM for trim tasks. EA for furniture clear per room and fixture counts. EA_ROOM for per-room heuristics. FIXED for assessment tasks and customer walkthrough. SF not used directly for trim tasks (LF = SF per PDCA convention).

substrate_state.notes: All 5 interior RP substrate states accepted. Output normalizes to standard SS_PAINTED_* per selected sheen.

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale per controlled_enums.json. Drives prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.

consumable_category.notes: All categories valid for trim RP. 'tool' covers contour scrapers, detail scrapers, adhesion test kits.

product_role.notes: Primer = state-driven RP primers. Finish = fine-finish QT-driven systems. Specialty = shellac stain blocker, degloss solution.

yield_uom.notes: LF primary yield UOM for trim consumables. EA for per-unit tools.

protection_level.notes: edge_only for floor_perimeter. light_mask for wall_adjacent brush. full_mask for wall_adjacent spray. partial_cover for furniture_room.

floor_type.notes: RP ALWAYS has finished floors. Subfloor and partial not applicable to interior RP.

surface_ids.primary_surface_note: Baseboard is representative. Adjacency analysis applies to all 9 trim types. All share wall_field adjacency.
surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs are existing in id_registry.json surface_ids entries_in_active_use. wall_field: all trim types. ceiling_field: crown only. door_frame: door casing. window_frame: window casing.

zone_ids.notes: Runner-style drop cloths along trim perimeter. Always required in RP.
Wall masking at trim edge. Always required in RP (walls always finished). Brush: light_mask (tape). Spray: full_mask (tape + paper).
Cover outlets/switches near spray zone. Spray method only.
RP-specific. Move items away from trim work zones. Lighter scope than wall RP. Conditional on occupancy_state. Proposed in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP resolution — shared across interior RP specs.

material_system_prefix.notes: All 6 material systems are existing and shared. Three RP primer systems (adhesion, stain-block, mildew) are shared with wall RP per the instruction that these CAN be reused. Three fine-finish systems (QT3/QT4/QT5) are shared with NC trim and all other fine-finish specs. No new material systems needed for this spec.

proposed_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
proposed_consumables.justification: RP-specific: chemical degloss for existing paint. Not used in NC trim specs. Krud Kutter Gloss-Off or equivalent.

proposed_consumables.name: Contour Scraper for Profile Trim
proposed_consumables.justification: RP trim prep requires contour scrapers for profile trim. Not used in NC (no scraping on bare substrate). Distinct from standard putty knife.

proposed_consumables.name: Contour Sanding Sponge
proposed_consumables.justification: Flexible sanding sponge for profile trim prep and interstage. Conforms to crown, ogee, and complex profiles. Distinct from flat rigid sanding block.

proposed_consumables.name: RP Assessment Kit (adhesion test + solvent test)
proposed_consumables.justification: Includes cross-hatch cutter, pressure-sensitive tape (ASTM D3359), mineral spirits, white rags for coating ID. RP-specific assessment supplies. Shared across interior RP specs.

proposed_rounds.description: Conditional prime + 2 finish coats (standard RP sequence: state-driven prime + 2 finish coats with interstage)
proposed_rounds.notes: Prime coat is conditional on substrate state. FAIR/POOR always requires prime. GOOD may skip prime.

proposed_rounds.description: 2 finish coats only (GOOD condition, no prime needed — sound paint with adhesion verified)
proposed_rounds.notes: Skip prime when adhesion test passes and existing paint is sound.

proposed_rounds.description: Prime + 3 finish coats (QT5 + brush per FFD 15.10.3 + FAIR/POOR condition)
proposed_rounds.notes: Maximum coat sequence: state-driven prime + 3 brush finish coats.

proposed_rounds.description: 3 finish coats only (QT5 + brush + GOOD condition)
proposed_rounds.notes: QT5 brush adds 3rd finish coat even without prime.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for adhesion primer on previously painted trim. Different from bare-wood primer coverage.
proposed_profiles.notes: Adhesion primer on sound/failing paint has different absorption than bare wood. Expect 350-450 SF/gal equivalent.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for shellac stain blocker on smoke-damaged trim.
proposed_profiles.notes: Shellac primers have lower coverage than latex. Expect 250-350 SF/gal.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for mildew-resistant primer on moisture-damaged trim.
proposed_profiles.notes: Similar coverage to adhesion primer. Expect 350-400 SF/gal.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared per instruction. Drives prep pool: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.
Shared per instruction. Drives treatment task activation and primer selection.

existing_modifiers_from_nc.notes: Transfers from NC trim unchanged. Simple=0.85x, Standard=1.00x, Complex=1.25x, Ornate=1.40x. Applied per-item-type.
Transfers from NC trim unchanged. H1=1.00x, H2=1.30x, H3=1.50x. H4 excluded for interior.

prep_pool.flag_note: Slightly exceeds 4.0x flag at extreme. Achievable in real scenarios (poor condition crown with ornate profiles in tall space). Flag for estimator review.

coordination_notes: Trim RP may run alongside wall RP (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP) in full interior repaint. Sequencing: trim first, then walls (80% default per A-005).
Door casing adjacency with SF_DOOR_INT_RP (if it exists) — coordination required if both specs active on same project.
Window casing adjacency with SF_WINDOW_INT_RP — coordination required if both specs active.
MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all interior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: Every TSK_ context prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 10: Every ITM_ marked 'existing' in resolution.json MUST use the exact registered ID
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Trim Repaint (Combined Prime + Finish)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for interior trim repaint. Covers 9 trim types. Combined prime + finish RP. No existing SF_ covers interior trim RP.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Trim Repaint Task Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix TMRP for interior trim RP tasks. Avoids collision with TSK_TRIM_* (NC), TSK_SETUP_* (NC), TSK_WLRP_* (wall RP), TSK_CLRP_* (ceiling RP).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Trim Repaint Module Prefix

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim RP: Prime + 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush)

registry_additions_proposed.name: Trim RP: 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush, No Prime)

registry_additions_proposed.name: Adhesion Primer Coverage on Painted Trim
